Updated `src/solution.py` to reject requests exceeding capacity, including requests for unavailable resources, while requiring some capacity to remain unallocated. Removed unnecessary input-type restrictions and preserved public function signatures.

Verified with 15 edge cases and 4,096 exhaustive allocation cases.
